title: Summa contra Gentiles
html_source:
The Summa contra Gentiles, also known as the Summa contra Gentes, is one of the best-known books by St Thomas Aquinas.

The Summa contra Gentiles is often portrayed as an early missionary’s manual or handbook…it was written to explain and defend the “Christian truth” in hostile situations against unbelievers, with arguments adapted to fit the intended circumstances of its use, each article refuting a certain heretical belief or proposition.
Wikipedia
